B-XfGY2glUK.cap: We can all do our part!! I was contacted by a friend of mine who is on the front lines of this epidemic. He is an emergency room doctor! He asked if I could make these boxes that he saw on Twitter being used in Taiwan. I was on board from the start.  After having two of these boxes already out there in use today at Virtua hospital in Voorhees in at a hospital in Hackensack. Justin Skolnick and I have a refine the design which you’ll see a picture of. I am working with local manufacturers and a manufacture in Florida. Right now we are only working on donations. Each box takes about $80 to make materials only.  I have about 40 boxes on order as of now with enough money to make 30 boxes. But I have more people asking every few hours so please re-post this and keep us in mind for some donations.  My Venmo is @Seth-Pearlman-1View all comments

B-SvI4JgtXq.cap:
*PLEASE SHARE THIA IT CAN SAVE LIVES*  We can all do our part!! I was contacted by a friend of mine who is on the front lines of this Epidemic. He is an emergency room doctor!! He asked if I could make these boxes that he saw on Twitter being used in Taiwan. I was in from the start for sure.  I am happy to say that he will be picking two of them up tonight to be used in two separate Emergency rooms. I made these ABSOLUTELY FREE of charge.  Materials donated to me by #lowesvoorhees . 
I am willing to make a few more for anyone on the front lines as long as #lowesvoorhees will continue to donate the materials. 
Good luck with these unprecedented times to all of you out there on the front lines...
